Assume (S). Let G be a finite connected simple graph with n >= 3 vertices and degree 2 at every vertex.
Its maximum degree is at most 2, so (S) says that G is a path or a cycle. A path on at least three vertices has
endpoints of degree 1, contradicting the degrees in G. Therefore G is a cycle. This proves the stated implication
with threshold 3. The argument assumes (S) and does not prove it.
